description: Displays details for a selected modeling element or relationship. Read-only (MO2) by default; with ReadOnly=false the name, the description and the SCALAR properties become editable inputs raising OnElementEdited/OnRelationshipEdited — source-backed fields, governance and complex JSON values are never editable (decision MODELING-INSPECTOR-EDITING).

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: Selected modeling element. Takes precedence when both element and relationship are supplied.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the inspector root.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements used to resolve relationship source and target display names.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the inspector is read-only (the MO2 default). The editor passes false when model editing is enabled for the current provider — then the name, the description and the scalar properties become inputs that commit on blur/Enter (Escape reverts); semantic type, notation, source metadata, governance and complex JSON values stay read-only.

parameters.name: OnElementEdited
parameters.description: Raised when an element field commit lands. The change carries only the edited fields (a null member means unchanged).

parameters.name: OnRelationshipEdited
parameters.description: Raised when a relationship field commit lands.

parameters.name: OnUndoRequested
parameters.description: Raised for the inspector-scope Ctrl+Z — the editor's own undo stack, never the diagram canvas keyboard scope.

parameters.name: OnRedoRequested
parameters.description: Raised for the inspector-scope Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Editor-owned actions rendered inside the header (the undo/redo pair and the docked Save/Discard while a Manual save is pending).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__type-icon
cssClasses.description: Header icon tile resolved from the semantic type (Link2 for relationships).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__heading
cssClasses.description: Header text column: kind chip, name, type.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__name
cssClasses.description: The h3 name of the inspected element/relationship.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__edit-field
cssClasses.description: Wrapper of the name/description fields in the editing surface.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__header-actions
cssClasses.description: Cluster of the editor-hosted header actions (undo/redo pair, docked Save/Discard).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__property-edit
cssClasses.description: Editable scalar property cell (the key cell stays the label).
